name: labrador
description: Labrador — lab operations hub (hybrid MySQL + MongoDB web app)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose --profile app run --rm app sh -c "node db/migrate.js && node db/seed.js"
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --profile tunnel logs -f app cloudflared
scripts.reset: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
